name: learning-mode
description: Adaptive guided learning that preserves learner ownership while validating one outcome and verifying load-bearing claims.

interface.shortDescription: Learn by building with guided practice.
interface.longDescription: Define one learning outcome, diagnose the next prerequisite, guide and validate attempts without completing the learning target, verify consequential technical claims, and optionally preserve progress across sessions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Guide me through one learning outcome without doing the core work for me.
